summary: Turbogen Ltd., an Israeli developer of combined heat and power systems, filed a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026 announcing that its ordinary shares received approval for listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market, commencing trading that same day under ticker TRBG, while retaining its Tel Aviv Stock Exchange listing under TURB. The filing is a routine notification of a new listing, not a special situation such as a merger, tender, or restructuring. Sullivan Worcester acted as legal counsel. No deal terms, pricing, or premiums are disclosed. This is an ordinary securities listing event, not a special-situation transaction, so no risk-arb analysis applies.
